summary: The new audit report (ai-os/audits/reporting_module_reaudit_2026-07-27.md) and the ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml claim registration are sound, well-evidenced, and consistent with this repo's Rule 11 protocol. However, the PROGRESS.md diff is destructive and misrepresented: a single hunk deletes roughly 280 lines of historical progress records spanning at least five unrelated prior tasks (task-101145, task-132826, task-100954, task-101123, task-093117, including a nested corrective-fix subsection), and replaces them with this re-audit task's own completed-items list -- left mislabeled under the untouched old header '# PROGRESS -- task-20260727-101145-reporting-api-gateway--external-ai-scope', so the file now reads as if that old task's work was the re-audit's own notes. This violates this repo's own established append-only convention for PROGRESS.md (referenced in this branch's own recent merge commits) and contradicts the audit report's explicit claim that 'nothing changed outside this one file' / the only non-report change was the ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml entry -- that claim is false, and the PROGRESS.md rewrite is not disclosed anywhere in the report. Real documentation history for five other completed tasks has been silently lost.
issues: PROGRESS.md: ~280 lines of historical progress records for 5 unrelated prior tasks (task-101145, task-132826, task-100954, task-101123, task-093117) were deleted and replaced with this task's own notes, mislabeled under the old task-101145 header -- breaks this repo's append-only PROGRESS.md convention and destroys prior audit trail.

The audit report's own 'Cross-cutting notes' section falsely states the only non-report change was the ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml claim entry; it omits and does not disclose the PROGRESS.md rewrite/deletion described above.

Recommend requesting a corrective PR that restores the deleted PROGRESS.md task sections (or moves them to an archive file) and appends the new task's entry under its own correct header instead of overwriting another task's section.
